import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional

/-!
Scratch probe (ajc-fbc r2), THE PER-SIGMA MATE.

Residue after the whiskering rewrite + `isIso_app_pi_of_isIso_app`:

    ∀ σ, IsIso ((cechOuterBC f g f' g' h).app (pushPullObj F (Over.mk j_σ)))

where `j_σ = ι (coverInterOpen 𝒰 σ)` and `pushPullObj F (Over.mk j_σ) = (j_σ)_* ((j_σ)^* F)`.

THE IDEA THAT MAKES THIS TRACTABLE, and it is the standard proof of 02KG.  The mate of a
VERTICAL COMPOSITE of two squares is the vertical composite of the mates
(`mateEquiv_vcomp`, mathlib).  Stack the inner square over `U_σ` on top of the outer square:

     U'_σ --gV--> U_σ            (inner: base change of j_σ along g')
      |p'          |j_σ
      v            v
      X' --g'-->   X             (outer-X)
      |f'          |f
      v            v
      S' --g-->    S             (outer-S)

The composite of the top two squares is the square for `j_σ ≫ f`, i.e. for `U_σ ⟶ S`. So

    mate(j_σ ≫ f square) = mate(inner) ∘ᵥ mate(outer)   [up to the pseudofunctor coherences]

and evaluating at `(j_σ)^* F` turns the LHS into a mate for a morphism U_σ ⟶ S BETWEEN AFFINE
SCHEMES — where flatness of g gives it directly. The mate(inner) factor is
`openImmersion_beckChevalley`, ALREADY sorry-free in this file (j_σ IS an open immersion).

So the per-σ obligation splits as:
  (i)  the AFFINE mate over U_σ ⟶ S is an iso  (affine base change; g flat) -- the honest core
  (ii) mate(vertical composite) = mate ∘ᵥ mate  -- mathlib's mateEquiv_vcomp
  (iii) mate(inner) is an iso -- openImmersion_beckChevalley, LANDED

Test whether (i) is reachable, i.e. what the file has for the affine S-level mate.
-/

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open Scheme.Modules

variable {S S' X X' : Scheme.{u}}

-- Is there an affine-to-affine version of the S-level mate being an iso anywhere?
#check @affinePushforwardPullbackBaseChange
#check @cech_degree_affine_baseChange
#check @CategoryTheory.mateEquiv_vcomp

end AlgebraicGeometry
